name: Creature Spawn Data Template
description: A reusable spawn-time override template for creature_template values (npc/unit flags, faction, model, equipment, health/mana, spawn behavior flags), applied to spawns that reference it instead of repeating the same overrides on every guid.

fields.name: Npc Flags
fields.help: Overrides creature_template.npcflag for spawns using this template. -1 = don't override.

fields.name: Unit Flags
fields.help: Overrides UNIT_FLAGS (low 32 bits) and UNIT_FLAGS_2 (high 32 bits) for spawns using this template; the loader reads the column as a single 64-bit value. -1 = don't override. Flag labels are wotlk names; bits whose meaning differs on TBC are annotated.

fields.name: Faction
fields.help: Overrides creature_template.faction for spawns using this template.

fields.name: Model Id
fields.help: Overrides the display model for spawns using this template.

fields.name: Equipment Id
fields.help: Overrides the equipment_template id. -1 = don't override, 0 = no equipment.

fields.name: Cur Health
fields.help: Current health to spawn with (absolute, not percent).

fields.name: Relay Id
fields.help: dbscripts_on_relay script id executed on spawn, if any.

fields.name: String Id
fields.help: Optional string id (must exist as a registered ScriptMgr string id) used to target spawns using this template from db-scripts by name.

fields.name: Name
fields.help: Developer-facing template name/comment (should not be empty).
